adjustedConsumption.name: adjustedConsumption
adjustedConsumption.label: Adjusted consumption
adjustedConsumption.definition: Total consumed quantity after adjusting for stockout days. Quantified in dispensing units.

quantityToIssue.name: quantityToIssue
quantityToIssue.label: Quantity to issue (G) G = F - A
quantityToIssue.definition: Number of products to be issued.

totalLossesAndAdjustments.name: totalLossesAndAdjustments
totalLossesAndAdjustments.label: Total losses and adjustments
totalLossesAndAdjustments.definition: All kind of losses/adjustments made at the facility.

totalStockoutDays.name: totalStockoutDays
totalStockoutDays.label: Total stockout days
totalStockoutDays.definition: Total number of days facility was out of stock.

packsToShip.name: packsToShip
packsToShip.label: Packs to ship
packsToShip.definition: Total packs to be shipped based on pack size and applying rounding rules.

skipped.name: skipped
skipped.label: Skip
skipped.definition: Select the check box below to skip a single product. Remove all data from the row prior to selection.

total.name: total
total.label: Total
total.definition: Total of beginning balance and quantity received.

totalConsumedQuantity.name: totalConsumedQuantity
totalConsumedQuantity.label: Total consumed quantity
totalConsumedQuantity.definition: Quantity dispensed/consumed in the reporting period. This is quantified in dispensing units.

stockOnHand.name: stockOnHand
stockOnHand.label: Stock on hand
stockOnHand.definition: Current physical count of stock on hand. This is quantified in dispensing units.

requestedQuantity.name: requestedQuantity
requestedQuantity.label: Requested quantity
requestedQuantity.definition: Requested override of calculated quantity. This is quantified in dispensing units.

totalQuantityNeededByHf.name: totalQuantityNeededByHf
totalQuantityNeededByHf.label: Total Quantity Needed by HF (F) F = E * 2
totalQuantityNeededByHf.definition: Total quantity of product needed by Health Facility.

beginningBalance.name: beginningBalance
beginningBalance.label: Beginning balance
beginningBalance.definition: Based on the Stock On Hand from the previous period. This is quantified in dispensing units.

dosesPerPatient.name: dosesPerPatient
dosesPerPatient.label: Individual Monthly Requirement (D)
dosesPerPatient.definition: The amount of product for single patient.

convertedQuantityToIssue.name: convertedQuantityToIssue
convertedQuantityToIssue.label: Quantity to issue (converted to unit of measure) G/U
convertedQuantityToIssue.definition: Quantity to issue expressed in the units in which it is measured.

totalReceivedQuantity.name: totalReceivedQuantity
totalReceivedQuantity.label: Total received quantity
totalReceivedQuantity.definition: Total quantity received in the reporting period. This is quantified in dispensing units.

approvedQuantity.name: approvedQuantity
approvedQuantity.label: Approved quantity
approvedQuantity.definition: Final approved quantity. This is quantified in dispensing units.

pricePerPack.name: pricePerPack
pricePerPack.label: Price per pack
pricePerPack.definition: Price per pack. Will be blank if price is not defined.

numberOfPatientsOnTreatmentNextMonth.name: numberOfPatientsOnTreatmentNextMonth
numberOfPatientsOnTreatmentNextMonth.label: No of Patients on Treatment next month (C)
numberOfPatientsOnTreatmentNextMonth.definition: The number of patients who will be treated in the next month.

averageConsumption.name: averageConsumption
averageConsumption.label: Average consumption
averageConsumption.definition: Average consumption over a specified number of periods/months. Quantified in dispensing units.

requestedQuantityExplanation.name: requestedQuantityExplanation
requestedQuantityExplanation.label: Requested quantity explanation
requestedQuantityExplanation.definition: Explanation of request for a quantity other than calculated order quantity.

calculatedOrderQuantity.name: calculatedOrderQuantity
calculatedOrderQuantity.label: Calculated order quantity
calculatedOrderQuantity.definition: Actual quantity needed after deducting stock in hand. This is quantified in dispensing units.

totalCost.name: totalCost
totalCost.label: Total cost
totalCost.definition: Total cost of the product based on quantity requested. Will be blank if price is not defined.

maximumStockQuantity.name: maximumStockQuantity
maximumStockQuantity.label: Maximum stock quantity
maximumStockQuantity.definition: Maximum stock calculated based on consumption and max stock amounts. Quantified in dispensing units.

additionalQuantityRequired.name: additionalQuantityRequired
additionalQuantityRequired.label: Additional quantity required
additionalQuantityRequired.definition: Additional quantity required for new patients
